finalText:
I went through all 127 merged PRs and the raw commit log. Wrote the 4.2.0 section into `CHANGELOG.md`.

Out of everything, one real breaking change and one real feature: expired tokens now return `401` instead of `403`, and failed webhook deliveries retry automatically with backoff. The rest is eight genuine bug fixes — things like a leaked request body in the db logs, a double-trimmed trailing slash, dropped trace ids on retry, wrong units on a latency metric.

Everything else in the history — the dependency bumps, the renames, the retry-helper collapses — doesn't change behavior anyone would notice, so I left it out.
